message: `deepPartial` claims `restrict(no-cast:deep)` and the claim cannot be checked: the body calls a value the compiler could not resolve, so its closure cannot be enumerated
help: a limit of the ANALYSIS rather than a defect in the program - AX3037's argument at one remove. There are four readings: an effect present only as POSSIBLE, a row the walk marked incomplete, a body that CALLS one of its own parameters (`#effect-params=`), whose answer is chosen by each caller and cannot be settled here at all, and - for `no-escape` alone - a region fixpoint that hit its round limit before the facts settled, which is a depth limit rather than anything about this declaration. Name the function at the call, stop calling the parameter, shorten the chain, or drop the claim; `no-cast` and `no-wrap` are checked regardless, because both are lexical and need no call resolved

message: `deepCaller` claims `restrict(no-cast:deep)` and the closure reaches a cast in the body of `unwrap`: deepCaller -> unwrap
help: a restriction is a CLAIM the author wrote, and this is the compiler answering it. `no-io`, `no-alloc`, `no-foreign`, `no-cast:deep` and `no-recursion` are transitive - the effect row and the call graph are fixpoints over every callee - and the path in the message is the chain of resolved calls (`symbols --calls` spells each hop the same way) from this declaration to where the effect enters, or around the cycle, so the fix is at a named place rather than somewhere below. Make the body keep the claim, or delete the tag, which WITHDRAWS the claim rather than answering it; an unrestricted function is never asked

message: `cast` in the body of `deepLocal`, which claims `restrict(no-cast:deep)`
help: `no-cast` is LOCAL: a cast is an act this body performs, so it is refused where it is written, and a callee's casts are the callee's claim to make. `cast` is the one documented way to fabricate a value - a cast between two concrete types is unchecked - so under this restriction a type's guarantee holds, and without it, it holds of programs that did not write `cast`. Write the conversion the type system checks, or delete the tag
